assessments.reasoning: The accessible mirror carries ISO/IEC 7185:1990(E) identification, clause structure, and edition content. Edition and title were checked against the IEC publication record. Fresh capture digest aaef1d686020d7bea96de8ce77f21ee9715c37a3c9d412ec998768aff80c82f6 binds the full inspected response. The controlling passage is §6.4.2.2(c) Required simple-types, PDF page 22. ISO/IEC 7185:1990 requires Pascal Boolean to denote an ordinal type whose values are the truth values represented by false and true. This concerns the required type identifier Boolean and its required constants. The standard's logical domain establishes no hardware or memory representation for this claim. Other simple types are described in separate lettered subclauses and do not broaden the Boolean domain.
